title: Determine Your Version of Microsoft Project
author: Mark Edmonds
excerpt: In order to determine your version of Microsoft Project, including Service Packs, do the following:
content:
In order to determine your version of Microsoft Project, including Service Packs, do the following:

Microsoft Project 2013/2016

  1. Open fastProjectAI (or Microsoft Project)

  2. From the Ribbon, File > Account

  3. Over on the right, click "About Project"

  4. At the top you will see the relevant information (example below). Take a screenshot and send it to us.
